==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. A variant of myself from the Storyverse kills Johnson. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.) (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (Evil Variant Dragon Mask Jet looks like me with a hockey mask shaped like a dragon head. He wields a hockey stick and he radiates with a red and black sparkling energy. His Dark Dragon energy is immune to Lucid Light.)
He uses a power that is immune to Lucid Light that I can't undo.
Using the Reality Warping Stone, I travel through time and change my variant's history to prevent Johnson's death. (The Reality Warping Stone resembles a jagged diamond that is half pink and half yellow.) (I changed his history by changing the Dark Dragon Tome in his timeline to a Celestial Dragon Tome. Instead of corrupting him, the tome helped to shape him into a hero. I still don't know where he got the book in the first place, but I have a sinking suspicion that it was the work of another variant of mine.)
